entries.en:
Questioning your skills as an artisan, Yazel Ahuatan invites you to prove him wrong by crafting a bladder component with the materials he has provided. His challenge is further complicated by the requirement that you use special facilities in Hyrstmill to craft the component─facilities which are administered by Dametta, a woman of some repute, who may not be amenable to your request.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.

entries.en: Dametta is willing to grant you permission to use her facilities─provided you carry out a simple task in exchange. A particularly persistent opo<-->opo has been raiding her stores for some time, and she would have you permanently resolve the situation. With the aid of ripe Mun<-->Tuy beans, lure the beastkin out from his lair near E<-->Tatt's Spire and end his reign of terror once and for all. Alternatively, you could converse with the woman further and attempt to persuade her...but that approach may not end well.

The claw serves both to horrify Dametta's sensibilities and satisfy her requirements. With the materials provided to you by Yazel Ahuatan, synthesize a bladder component, and deliver it to him at Ehcatl.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Production wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Dametta.

Vous pouvez maintenant faire usage de l'installation d'artisanat. Servez-vous des matériaux pour fabriquer et apportez-le à Yazel Ahuatan, au centre d'essais d'Ehcatl.

entries.en: The most able of Ixal accepts your work with a mighty squa-hawk, satisfied with its quality. Within you he sees a great potential─one which he likens to his own, glimpsed by Chief Totoloc long ago. Weighty words indeed, one might say─though one must always consider the source, as well.
entries.fr: Lorsque vous lui avez remis <frnoun(Item,2,　8091,1,1)>, Yazel Ahuatan vous a raconté son histoire. Il semble heureux de pouvoir enfin rendre service à Sezul Totoloc qui l'a jadis recueilli et sera cer<->tai<->ne<->ment ravi si vous décidez d'apporter votre aide au projet des Planeurs d'Ehcatl.
entries.ja: 職工のヤゼル・アファタンに<sheet(Item,　8091,0)>を納品した。彼が仕事に打ち込む理由は、天涯孤独だった自分を育ててくれた親方に報いたいとの思いからだった。「デズル・クワラン号」の建造にたずさわる者たちは、それぞれの願いを込めて夢の飛空艇と向き合っているのだろう。

entries.en: Know you of opo<-->opos? Dreadful little scamps, always stealing my Mun<-->Tuy beans. One in particular has given me no end of trouble, and I will suffer it no longer! Pray use these ripe beans to lure him out from his lair near E<-->Tatt's Spire and end his reign of terror! And, though it's a grisly thing to ask, I must insist that you return with proof of the deed─a fang, or a claw, or something of that nature. Nothing too large, mind you. I don't want it as a trophy to hang on my wall. I'm not a monster!

entries.en: You see, he came through the other day and, like you, he wished to use these facilities. I told him─as I told you─that I would gladly permit him to do so, if only he first dealt with a certain opo<-->opo. So off he went for the better part of a day, eventually returning to report that the deed was done! Naturally, I was beside myself with joy, and I went to bed that night thinking that the opo<-->opo was no more and all was right with the world.

entries.en: My word, is that really... Oh gods, I can't bear to look at it! Take it from my sight and dispose of it─but not in the river! Now then, deep breaths... Though unusual, I don't believe your materials could be used for evil ends. Here you are. You'll note I didn't return them all─there are several times the required materials, it would seem. Whoever entrusted this task to you left a note in the bag: “To featherless neuker, give only required parts. In case of failure, retain spares.” Hmmm... What in the world is a “neuker”?
entries.fr: Chose promise, chose due, vous pouvez utiliser nos équipements comme bon vous semble<nbsp>!
